title: Early-Season Share of the Lending Limit on Operating Lines of Credit Program Products
content:
On an Operating Lines of Credit product that carries a program discount — the young, beginning and small farmer program — the lending limit available early in a term is held back in two steps.

## Rule

On a product with a program discount above zero, the lending limit is taken:

- **at 0.85 of itself** when the request falls fewer than 2 whole months after the start of the current term;
- **at 0.95 of itself** when it falls at least 2 but fewer than 4 whole months after it;
- **at the whole of itself** in every other case.

The start of the current term is the last renewal date, or the booking date for a line never renewed. The share multiplies the lending limit before the outstanding principal is taken off it.

## Figures by product

| Product | Program discount (points) | Fewer than 2 whole months | 2 to fewer than 4 whole months | 4 or more whole months |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| StartRight Operating Line | 1.0 (1) | 0.85 | 0.95 | Whole |
| ExpressLine Operating Credit, Seasonal Operating Loan, Revolving Operating Line, Borrowing Base Operating Line, Agribusiness Revolving Line | 0 | Whole | Whole | Whole |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical StartRight Operating Line, current term started 10 March)

| Request date | Whole months into the term | Share of the lending limit |
|---|---|---|
| 9 May | 1 | 0.85 |
| 10 May | 2 | 0.95 |
| 9 July | 3 | 0.95 |
| 10 July | 4 | Whole |
